reason: The day filter at packages/lib/slots.ts:206-208 compares `dayjs.utc(override.start)` with the invitee's day boundaries. But `override.start` is the organizer's wall-clock time stored as fake UTC (packages/core/getUserAvailability.ts:218-222), and the patch applies the organizer-to-invitee offset only to the hours/minutes at slots.ts:211-224, not to this day check. Example: an organizer at UTC+10 sets an override starting 08:00 on day D, which is 22:00 on day D-1 for a UTC invitee. The filter still puts it on day D, and the shifted hours come out as start 22:00 and an end earlier than the start.
